name: @pipobscure/bundle
description: Record what an application reads, archive it, sign it with sigstore, verify it, and mount it as a verifying node:vfs provider so only signed archives run.
author: Philipp Dunkel <pip@pipobscure.com>

scripts.manifest:
BUNDLE_MANIFEST=app.manifest node --no-warnings --experimental-vfs -r ./lib/record.cjs --vfs-load --vfs-mount lib/ help > /dev/null && printf 'provider.js
register.cjs
recorder.js
record.cjs
' >> app.manifest
scripts.create: node --no-warnings lib/app.js create --base lib/ --files app.manifest --output app.bundle
scripts.sign: node --no-warnings lib/app.js sign --key certs/leaf.key --chain certs/chain.pem --output app.signed.bundle app.bundle
scripts.archive: node --no-warnings lib/app.js sign --key certs/leaf.key --chain certs/chain.pem --prefix shell-base --output app.run app.bundle
scripts.executable: node --no-warnings lib/app.js sign --key certs/leaf.key --chain certs/chain.pem --prefix node-base --output app.sea app.bundle
scripts.sigstore: node --no-warnings lib/app.js sign --prefix shell-base --output app.run app.bundle
scripts.build: npm run manifest && npm run create && npm run sign && npm run archive
